title: ROPA30 - audit log entry
description: One entry of the ROPA30 activity log, which records operations on the register (creation, update and deletion of items, restore and reset of the database). Entries are never rewritten: values written by earlier versions remain valid as legacy values.

targetId.description: Identifier of the item affected ('all' for whole-database operations).

summary.description: Short human-readable description, in the language of the interface at the time of the operation.
